{
  "name": "timestamps",
  "displayName": "Timestamps",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Times on everything in Claude Code: your messages, replies, tool calls and 'replied 14:07 · took 1m 48s' on each turn. Optional: let Claude know the time too.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Parag Pandya",
    "url": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps",
  "repository": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "timestamps",
    "timestamp",
    "time",
    "clock",
    "duration",
    "time-aware",
    "claude-code",
    "transcript",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hour format",
      "description": "auto follows your system locale; or 12h / 24h",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "12h",
        "24h"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Style",
      "description": "clock shows 14:05; relative shows 5m ago (today's messages only)",
      "options": [
        "clock",
        "relative"
      ],
      "default": "clock"
    },
    "show": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where times appear",
      "description": "everything: under every row (your messages, Claude's replies, tool calls, command output). mine: under your own messages only",
      "options": [
        "everything",
        "mine"
      ],
      "default": "everything"
    },
    "showDuration": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show turn duration",
      "description": "Add 'took 1m 48s' to each turn's closing line",
      "default": true
    },
    "backfill": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Fill in older messages",
      "description": "On /resume or /branch, read this session's own transcript file to show times for messages from before the mod loaded",
      "default": true
    },
    "tellClaude": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Tell Claude the time (off by default)",
      "description": "Off by default. When on, adds a short timestamp note (about 22 tokens) beside each prompt, read by Claude only and sent to Anthropic with your prompt. Your words are never changed. Also: /timestamps claude on",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps/issues",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://github.com/paragpandyareal/claude-code-timestamps/blob/main/LICENSE"
}
